cases.title: Plugin hover card is orphaned on screen when its row is filtered out from under the pointer
cases.why: pluginCardEnter/Leave is an imperative singleton keyed to mouse events on the row (pluginHoverCard.tsx:31-52). Once the 450ms timer has fired the card is only torn down by mouseleave/mousedown/wheel/scroll - and removing an element from the DOM does NOT fire mouseleave in Chrome. Typing in the search box (or a registry refresh, or switching tab by keyboard) therefore unmounts the anchor row and leaves a position:fixed card floating over the app with no way to dismiss it except moving the pointer onto another row.

cases.why: Typed entry is the only path that can feed an arbitrary number into settings.json. cases.title: ?page=plugins loads ONLY the Plugin Manager chunk (store.ts must never be pulled in)
cases.why: main.tsx documents the lazy import as load-bearing: if the App/store chunk were ever pulled into the sub-page, importing store.ts would run module-level engine wiring (session/hello, midi/setThruTracks []) and wipe the live session's MIDI-thru routing the moment the tab opened. cases.title: When the engraved SVG is CSS-scaled (narrow pane) the playhead lands in the wrong place
cases.why: contentWidth has a hard floor of 320 px (SheetMusic.tsx:277) while .sm-page carries max-width:100%, so below ~368 px of pane width the SVG is scaled down by the browser. pageCoords() and Score.locate() both compensate with viewBox.width/rect.width, but applyTransport (line 404) writes raw layout pixels into the playhead transform — so click-to-locate reports the right musical position while the playhead is drawn at the unscaled x. cases.title: Key-signature select draws exactly |fifths| accidentals on EVERY staff of every system
cases.why: The key signature is drawn per staff by KeySignature/keySignatureSteps with a per-clef octave shift, and the space for it is reserved separately in prefixWidth/prefixSlots. Counting the measure group's direct glyph children isolates clef+key+meter from note accidentals (those are nested inside each element's own <g>), so the DELTA between two key settings must be exactly staffCount × Δ|fifths| — anything else means the signature is drawn on one staff only, drawn twice, or that the reserved prefix width and the drawn glyphs disagree.

cases.title: Print switches to paged layout for the print call, then restores the screen layout
cases.why: doPrint (SheetMusic.tsx:965-971) is a timing dance: setPrinting(true) → re-layout to paper pages → window.print() 120 ms later → setPrinting(false) 300 ms after that. If the re-layout has not landed when print fires, the user gets a continuous ribbon on paper; if the reset is lost, the pane stays stuck in paper mode. Stubbing window.print lets us observe the DOM exactly at the print instant without opening the OS print dialog.

cases.title: Split tool cuts the clip at the snapped click position (left half keeps the clip id and half the length)
cases.why: splitClips is fired only when the click is strictly inside the clip (ClipCanvas.tsx:1200-1207) and the engine keeps the original id as the LEFT half. A wrong snap mode, a wrong px->beat conversion, or the 1e-9 guards being off would split at the wrong beat or not at all — and the Inspector length is the only exact numeric readout of it.

cases.title: Clip move snaps the delta to the 1/16 grid, and Shift gives free (un-snapped) placement
cases.why: Two rules meet here: snapB is applied to the PRIMARY clip's new start (ClipCanvas.tsx:1380) and Shift must bypass it while still being the deferred-selection modifier (pendingToggle). If Shift were consumed as a selection toggle the second drag would not move the clip at all; if snapping were applied to the raw delta instead of the resulting start, the first drag would land off-grid.

cases.title: Dragging on the ruler's loop strip creates a new loop range and switches looping on
cases.why: The loop drag streams transient cmd/loop.set and commits once on release, and a 'create' drag must force enabled:true (Ruler.tsx:386-435). If the transient/commit pattern is broken the region snaps back on release; if the mode detection is wrong the existing 0..8 region is moved instead of a new one being created.

cases.title: Minimap click centres the arrangement viewport on the clicked beat
cases.why: miniScrollTo does beat = x/w*totalBeats then scrollX = beat*zoomX - viewW/2 clamped to the content (lib/vizMath). A wrong totalBeats (contentBeats padding), a missing clamp, or the brush/viewport mapping drifting would land the view somewhere else; the overlay h-scrollbar thumb is an independent readout of the resulting scrollX.

cases.title: Escape mid-drag cancels a clip move: the clip stays put and the drag HUD disappears
cases.why: The timeline key context's escape handler nulls dragRef and hides the HUD (ClipCanvas.tsx:2736-2744); the subsequent pointerup must then find no drag and commit nothing. If escape returned falsy (falling through to clearSelection) or the release path still saw the drag, the move would land anyway — and a leaked .drag-hud would sit over the UI.

cases.title: Hovering the velocity lane after touching a CC lane routes to the CC handler (wrong cursor/hit-test)
cases.why: onLaneMove/onLaneUp choose the velocity vs CC handler from laneCtlRef, which is only stamped on pointerdown by the lane that was last PRESSED — not by the lane under the pointer. cases.title: Clip Editor view is not refitted when an offline process changes the clip's length (Resample)
cases.why: The view only refits when the CLIP ID changes (ClipEditor.tsx:296-299, fitForRef). Process > Resample swaps the asset, resets srcOffsetSamples to 0 and rewrites lengthSamples (Commands.cpp clipProcessAudio resample), so the retained spp/scroll now describe a different sample axis: the audible window jumps in size or off-screen with no visual cue.
steps: Run SETUP-A1..A10 from clipeditor-01.

evaluate_script (measure the fitted audible span): () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'); const W=cv.width,H=cv.height; const d=ctx.getImageData(0,Math.round(H*0.85),W,1).data; const lum=[];for(let x=0;x<W;x++)lum.push(d[x*4]+d[x*4+1]+d[x*4+2]); const mn=Math.min(...lum),mx=Math.max(...lum),th=(mn+mx)/2; let x0=-1,x1=-1;for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(lum[x]>=th){if(x0<0)x0=x;x1=x;} window.__pre={x0,x1,W,frac:+(((x1-x0)/W).toFixed(3)),lenSec:document.querySelector('.ce-toolbar [title="Fade-in (seconds)"]')?.getAttribute('aria-valuemax')}; return window.__pre; }

cases.expected: The clip length changed (post lenSec differs from pre lenSec) and the audible span should still fill ~0.90-0.97 of the canvas because the editor refits to the new material. A post frac around half or above 0.99 (clipped at both edges) proves the view kept the stale spp/scroll of the previous asset.
cases.assertion: () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'); const W=cv.width,H=cv.height; const d=ctx.getImageData(0,Math.round(H*0.85),W,1).data; const lum=[];for(let x=0;x<W;x++)lum.push(d[x*4]+d[x*4+1]+d[x*4+2]); const mn=Math.min(...lum),mx=Math.max(...lum),th=(mn+mx)/2; let x0=-1,x1=-1;for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(lum[x]>=th){if(x0<0)x0=x;x1=x;} return { pre: window.__pre, post: {x0,x1,W,frac:+(((x1-x0)/W).toFixed(3)), lenSec: document.querySelector('.ce-toolbar [title="Fade-in (seconds)"]')?.getAttribute('aria-valuemax'), asset: document.querySelector('.ce-asset-name')?.textContent} }; }

cases.title: Clip Editor zoom keys and the Fit pill: H zooms in, Fit restores the fitted view
cases.why: Zoom routes through registerKeyContext("clipEditor") which bails unless paneVisible and focusedPane resolve to the clip editor (ClipEditor.tsx:827-860, keyboard.ts:212-236) - a genuinely fragile chain - and the ZoomPill Fit goes through a different path (zoomToFitPane) than the toolbar Fit button (fitForRef).
steps: Run SETUP-A1..A10 from clipeditor-01 (the double-click also sets focusedPane to clipEditor).

evaluate_script (measure the fitted span; helper reused below): () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'); const W=cv.width,H=cv.height; const d=ctx.getImageData(0,Math.round(H*0.85),W,1).data; const lum=[];for(let x=0;x<W;x++)lum.push(d[x*4]+d[x*4+1]+d[x*4+2]); const mn=Math.min(...lum),mx=Math.max(...lum),th=(mn+mx)/2; let x0=-1,x1=-1;for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(lum[x]>=th){if(x0<0)x0=x;x1=x;} window.__fit={x0,x1,frac:+(((x1-x0)/W).toFixed(3))}; return window.__fit; }
press_key "h" four times (each is a 1.25x zoom-in on the local spp)
Wait ~200 ms, then evaluate_script (same measurement, stash as window.__zoomed)
evaluate_script: () => { const b=document.querySelector('.ce-wave .zoom-pill-fit'); window.__fitTitle=b?.getAttribute('title'); b.click(); return window.__fitTitle; }
Wait ~200 ms, then run the assertion.
cases.expected: fit.frac ~0.90-0.97; after four H presses the audible range overflows the canvas (zoomed.frac ~1.0 with x0 at 0 and x1 at W-1); after clicking the Fit pill (title "Fit the whole waveform into view (F)") the span returns to ~0.90-0.97. Unchanged numbers after H mean the key never reached the clipEditor key context.
cases.assertion: () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'); const W=cv.width,H=cv.height; const d=ctx.getImageData(0,Math.round(H*0.85),W,1).data; const lum=[];for(let x=0;x<W;x++)lum.push(d[x*4]+d[x*4+1]+d[x*4+2]); const mn=Math.min(...lum),mx=Math.max(...lum),th=(mn+mx)/2; let x0=-1,x1=-1;for(let x=0;x<W;x++) if(lum[x]>=th){if(x0<0)x0=x;x1=x;} return { fitted: window.__fit, zoomed: window.__zoomed, fitTitle: window.__fitTitle, afterFit: {x0,x1,W,frac:+(((x1-x0)/W).toFixed(3))} }; }

cases.title: Envelope mode: canvas clicks add gain-envelope points and "Clear Envelope" enables/disables accordingly
cases.why: Envelope editing writes the clip's env array through a click-to-add-and-drag gesture with a neighbour-clamped index (ClipEditor.tsx:571-638) and its only honest state read-out is the context menu's Clear Envelope guard (ClipEditor.tsx:939-943). Right-click delete of a point is a separate branch (ClipEditor.tsx:913-923) that can desync from the committed array.
steps: Run SETUP-A1..A10 from clipeditor-01.
hover the '.ce-wave canvas' element (activates pointerId 1).

evaluate_script (record Clear Envelope's initial state via the context menu, then close it): () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:Math.round(r.left+r.width*0.6),clientY:Math.round(r.top+r.height*0.6)})); const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ctx-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.ellipsis')?.textContent.trim()==='Clear Envelope'); window.__env0={disabled:it?.getAttribute('aria-disabled'),title:it?.getAttribute('title')}; document.querySelector('.ctx-overlay')?.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true})); return window.__env0; }

evaluate_script: () => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ce-toolbar button.btn')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Envelope'); b.click(); return b.className; }   (must gain the "primary" class)

evaluate_script (add two envelope points at 35%/65% width, different heights): () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk=(t,x,y,btn)=>new PointerEvent(t,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:Math.round(x),clientY:Math.round(y),button:0,buttons:btn,pointerId:1,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true}); const pts=[[0.35,0.3],[0.65,0.7]]; for(const [fx,fy] of pts){ const x=r.left+r.width*fx, y=r.top+r.height*fy; try{cv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown',x,y,1));}catch(e){} try{cv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove',x+1,y,1));}catch(e){} try{cv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup',x+1,y,0));}catch(e){} } return true; }

Wait ~500 ms, then evaluate_script (re-open the context menu and read Clear Envelope): () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:Math.round(r.left+r.width*0.9),clientY:Math.round(r.top+r.height*0.9)})); const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ctx-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.ellipsis')?.textContent.trim()==='Clear Envelope'); window.__env1={disabled:it?.getAttribute('aria-disabled'),title:it?.getAttribute('title')}; it.click(); return window.__env1; }
Wait ~500 ms, then run the assertion.
cases.expected: Initially Clear Envelope is disabled with title "No envelope points"; after two envelope clicks it is enabled with title "Remove all gain-envelope points" (proving env points were committed); after clicking it the menu closes and re-opening shows it disabled again. The Envelope toolbar button stays highlighted (class contains "primary").
cases.assertion: () => { const cv=document.querySelector('.ce-wave canvas'); const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:Math.round(r.left+r.width*0.5),clientY:Math.round(r.top+r.height*0.2)})); const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ctx-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.ellipsis')?.textContent.trim()==='Clear Envelope'); const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ce-toolbar button.btn')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Envelope'); return { before: window.__env0, afterAdd: window.__env1, afterClear: {disabled: it?.getAttribute('aria-disabled'), title: it?.getAttribute('title')}, envButtonClass: btn?.className }; }
